content.title: Garment Assembly Audition | Wireframe Body, Panel Build and Studio Resolution
content.summary: A virtual tailor assembles one original jacket on an adult avatar before a clean studio audition. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult body scaffold retains fixed proportions throughout assembly. + Persistent design panels identify the same original garment from start to finish. + Every panel follows a visible attachment path to its intended body region. + Material and identity resolve only after structural fit is complete. + The final full-body pose proves integrated clothing, anatomy and identity without replacement.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one adult androgynous wireframe avatar beside three persistent panels showing an original cropped jacket design. Use close views to verify four copper fasteners, shoulder seams and hem alignment without hiding the fit in a cut. Transition the same adult avatar into a pale architectural studio and hold one full-body readiness pose.
required_anchors: One clearly adult body scaffold retains fixed proportions throughout assembly.
Persistent design panels identify the same original garment from start to finish.
Material and identity resolve only after structural fit is complete.
The final full-body pose proves integrated clothing, anatomy and identity without replacement.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A virtual tailor assembles one original jacket on an adult avatar before a clean studio audition. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先用线框人体和常驻服装设计板建立结构，裁片沿可见路径贴合躯干，再依次恢复材质、肤色与头发；终局离开装配态进入干净人物主视图，证明所有部件属于同一身份。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult body scaffold retains fixed proportions throughout assembly.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult body scaffold retains fixed proportions throughout assembly."

invariants.rule: Persistent design panels identify the same original garment from start to finish.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Persistent design panels identify the same original garment from start to finish."

invariants.rule: Every panel follows a visible attachment path to its intended body region.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Every panel follows a visible attachment path to its intended body region."

invariants.rule: Material and identity resolve only after structural fit is complete.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Material and identity resolve only after structural fit is complete."

invariants.rule: The final full-body pose proves integrated clothing, anatomy and identity without replacement.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final full-body pose proves integrated clothing, anatomy and identity without replacement."

slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
